# OmopOnDuckDB

The goal of **OmopOnDuckDB** is to … *clearly state the main goal of the
package*

## Installation

You can install the development version of OmopOnDuckDB from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("OHDSI/OmopOnDuckDB")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r
library(OmopOnDuckDB)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`duckdbSource()`](https://OHDSI.github.io/OmopOnDuckDB/reference/duckdbSource.md)
  : Create a \`DuckDB\` source
